name: env-doctor
description: CLI that validates environment variables against a schema, flags unsafe defaults, and generates .env.example files — without ever printing secret values.

scripts.check:bad: npx tsx src/cli.ts check --schema schemas/sample.schema.json --env fixtures/bad.env
scripts.check:good: npx tsx src/cli.ts check --schema schemas/sample.schema.json --env fixtures/good.env

author: Saeed Rumaneh
